value.name: diana meets bram in alley
value.description: Diana exits the theater into the alley and finds Bram Holloway already waiting for her there.
evidence: Diana steps out through a side door into the narrow alley behind the theater. A man is already there. BRAM HOLLOWAY (50s, precise, well-dressed) checks his watch as she approaches.

BRAM
Ms. Crane. I have been waiting.

value.name: bram explains he waited outside
value.description: Bram acknowledges Diana is in the middle of rehearsal and says he deliberately waited outside to intercept her.
evidence:
DIANA
We are mid-rehearsal.

BRAM
Which is why I waited outside.

value.name: diana asks about funding matter
value.description: Diana prompts Bram to explain the funding issue he claimed to have.
evidence: Diana crosses her arms.

DIANA
You said there was a funding matter.

value.name: bram offers fifty thousand sponsorship
value.description: Bram offers Diana fifty thousand dollars before opening night in exchange for a Friday box seat and program mention.
evidence:
BRAM
Fifty thousand dollars. Cash transfer, cleared before opening night. In return: a seat in the box on Friday and a mention in the program.

value.name: diana reacts to amount
value.description: Diana is visibly stunned by the size of Bram's offer and repeats the amount back to him.
evidence: Diana stares.

DIANA
Fifty thousand.

BRAM
Fifty thousand dollars.

value.name: diana questions brams motive
value.description: Diana challenges Bram's sudden interest in theater, noting he has never cared about it before.
evidence:
DIANA
Why? You have never shown interest in theater.

BRAM
I am interested now.

value.name: bram confirms limited terms
value.description: Diana verifies the deal's conditions and Bram insists the box seat and program credit are his only terms.
evidence:
DIANA
And your terms are only what you said. Box seat. Program credit.

BRAM
That is all.

value.name: diana accepts and promises paperwork
value.description: After considering the offer, Diana agrees and says she will prepare the paperwork by morning.
evidence: Diana considers. Then:

DIANA
I will have the paperwork by morning.

value.name: bram departs after agreement
value.description: Bram expresses anticipation for Friday and leaves Diana alone in the alley.
evidence:
BRAM
I look forward to Friday.
He steps away into the dark. Diana watches him go

value.name: diana reflects on windfall
value.description: Left alone, Diana looks back at the theater and quietly repeats the amount, underscoring its significance to her.
evidence: then looks back at the lit windows of the theater.

DIANA
(to herself)
Fifty thousand dollars.
